work.author: United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit
work.description: A Second Circuit hot-news misappropriation decision. Having quoted International News Service's condemnation of reaping where one has not sown, Judge Sack's footnote 27 turns Galatians 6:7 - the verse the 1962 Missal appoints at the Fifteenth Sunday after Pentecost - against the founding metaphor of American unfair-competition law. A locus is a printed page of 650 F.3d, or a numbered footnote.
work.title: Barclays Capital Inc. v. Theflyonthewall.com, Inc., 650 F.3d 876 (2d Cir. 2011)
